name: Cross entropy
description: Class-index or probability-target cross entropy; PyTorch class axis, ignore_index, class weights, label smoothing, and none/mean/sum reduction.

examples.title: Train a classifier with cross entropy
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 x = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 return {"features": x, "labels": int(x[0] > 0)}
ds = synth.Spec("ce", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
val = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="val", like=train)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "cross-entropy"}, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result = trainer.evaluate(val)
